decisions.reason: The vacuum thermoforming unit sits close to the core dental-lab offer and has been presented on its own page for two consecutive years, so it is cheap to keep and still holds value as part of the integrated system.

The orthopedic shoe last is distant from the core business and its prospects are highly uncertain, but it was only launched in 2024 and shares the digital manufacturing know-how, so the option is worth keeping open until market results reveal more.

The post-curing unit complements the firm's digital printing workflow at low holding cost, and the evidence is still too early to justify abandoning it even though it is only mentioned on the website.
